title: Trader Diary: 77k Rollercoaster
content:
🚀 Spot price jumps 1.4% and my brain screams 'FOMO!'
📈 5‑minute chart later I'm whispering to my 10x futures: 'Just one more candle, bro...'
lesson: A 1.4% move isn’t a signal to max‑out leverage—keep the stop loss tighter than your coffee budget.
question: Who else cranked up a 10x position at $77,328? Be honest 👇
